text:
Nina: Quick thread to finalize GA acceptance for the Throttle+ routing feature. We need owners for SLA sign-off, billing smoke, user docs, canary schedule, and dashboards. Can we lock responsibilities now?
Carlos: I can run SLA validation and the synthetic perf passes. Target: hosted p99 <= 210ms for GA window, availability 99.95%. Dedicated gets throughput SLA + 99.9% avail.
Hannah: I'll own docs and the customer pricing examples. Will embed a short billing-smoke snippet and an FAQ about surge charges.
Leo: I'll lead canary and runtime fallbacks. Suggest warmup 1h @2%, then stage: 10% x8h, 40% x12h, 100% if stable. Auto-rollback triggers: p99 > 280ms or errors > 0.25% for 5m. Also will keep a fallback 0.5% route to previous model family.
Nina: Ops, please file intake tickets and schedule canary. @ops-bot
ops-bot: Created tickets INF-8801 (SLA tests), INF-8802 (Canary plan), INF-8803 (Billing smoke). Links: https://go/infra/INF-8802
Carlos: Test plan summary: 1) Synthetic: 45k QPS for 20m measuring p95/p99 + GPU tail utilization. 2) Replay: 6h prod mix at 20k QPS. Acceptance: p99 <=210ms and sustained error rate <0.08% for 10m.
Hannah: Billing-smoke checklist (short):
```
- Send sample requests for short/med/long seqs (8,128,1024)
- Verify invoice lines: model, tokens, storage, dedicated surcharge
- Confirm per-request token pricing is reflected in test invoice
- End-to-end: create test org -> emit 200 requests -> inspect invoice
```
Hannah: example cURL for billing-smoke:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \\
  -H "Authorization: Bearer test_key" \\
  -d '{"model":"throttle-v1","input":"hi","max_tokens":32}'
```
Leo: Observability asks: per-route p95/p99, traffic-split, KV-cache hit rate, request-length histogram, and token-cost per-request metric. Add eval-harness regression alert on control prompt set.
Carlos: Need tracing hooks added by runtime so we can attribute latency to cache/kernel/h2. I'll coordinate with infra and post test artifacts here.
Hannah: Docs timeline: draft by Tue EOD, final by next Mon after reviews. Finance, can you share a sample invoice template? @finance-bot
finance-bot: Sent sample invoice template to Hannah and included monthly cost calc for 100k requests.
Nina: GA go/no-go checklist we agreed on: 
- SLA load tests pass (Carlos)
- Billing-smoke completed and invoice sanity checked (Hannah + Finance)
- Canary executed per plan with no rollbacks for 48h at 100% (Leo + SRE)
- Runbook and user docs published (Hannah)
- Dashboards + regression alerts live (Carlos)
If any item fails -> hold GA and follow rollback playbook.
Carlos: Scheduling synthetic runs tomorrow morning and will publish JSON artifacts here.
Leo: Will land fallback PR and canary scripts today. ETA 5pm.
Hannah: Starting docs, will @mention reviewers when draft ready.
Nina: Thanks all, flag blockers in the tickets. Tag me if anything looks like a showstopper. :thumbsup:
